第96章 丧尸帝国（10）-《反派BOSS有毒》

白虎的空间竟然能装活的丧尸？

这本中，只有戚明雪那个空间可以装活物，其余人的空间异能都没办法装活的，丧尸也是有生命的，除非是尸体，否则是绝对装不进去的。

而现在白虎的空间竟然可以装活物……

她是该高兴呢还是该忧伤啊？

这丫的竟然拿去装丧尸，妈个鸡想想以后她用来装食物的地方装过丧尸……

心痛到无以附加！

千黎把那些丧尸赶下去，然后眼巴巴的瞅着她——手指。

时笙将手握紧，背到身后。

离家出走回来还想吃！

吃个毛线！

“嗬嗬……要……”千黎绕到时笙后面，伸手拉住她的手，直接往嘴里塞，凉凉的舌尖不断的在她指尖上打转。

时笙将手抽回来，不理会千黎如小狗一般可怜兮兮的表情，“你这几天去哪儿了？说不出就别吃饭！”

显然未来的丧尸皇大人不懂时笙这话是什么意思，绕着时笙不断的转悠。

时笙：“……”她和一个没有智商的未来丧尸皇说个毛线啊！简直是掉智商！

天亮时笙才发现千黎的变化。

他脸上已经完全和正常人一样，只有那双眸子依旧呆滞，不看时笙的时候死气沉沉阴森森的，看着非常的骇人。

时笙发现千黎和白虎没办法和平共处，属于那种，你看我不顺眼，我看你很碍眼。

在村子里找了辆破车，时笙开着车摇摇晃晃的上路。千黎听她说话，也能简单的说出一些词汇，智商明显比之前高了不少。

他消失的那几天估计是去晋级了。

也不知道这货现在是什么等级。

她依旧要去B市，B市是这附近最大的基地，直升机这种东西，应该在末世开始不久，就被集中了起来，只能在那里找到直升机，然后去京城——找妈妈。

如果是走陆地，以此时的状况，她不知道要走到何年何月去了。

开裂的乡村马路上，废弃的车子越来越多，地上断肢残腿，混合着稀泥和鲜血，空气中散发着恶心的味道，令人作呕。

时笙开到这里，就没办法继续往前开了。

将东西全部收到白虎空间，时笙带着千黎下车往前面走。

前面被堵成了一条长龙，时笙走了好一阵才走过去，但是……

White Tiger's space can hold live zombies?

In this book, only Qi Mingxue's space can hold living creatures, and the other people's space powers cannot hold living things. Zombies are also alive, and unless they are corpses, they will never be able to hold them.

And now the white tiger's space can actually hold living things...

Should she be happy or sad?

This girl actually used it to store zombies. Damn it, think about it, the place she used to store food will contain zombies in the future...

The heartache is beyond words!

Qian Li drove the zombies away, then looked at her-finger eagerly.

Shi Sheng clenched his hands and put them behind his back.

I still want to eat it after I ran away from home!

Eat a piece of wool!

"Ho ho... want to..." Qian Li walked around behind Shi Sheng, reached out to hold her hand, and stuffed it directly into her mouth, while her cool tongue kept swirling around her fingertips.

Shi Sheng pulled his hand back and ignored Qian Li's puppy-like expression, "Where have you been these days? If you can't tell me, don't eat!"

Obviously, the future Zombie Emperor didn't understand what Shi Sheng meant, and kept wandering around Shi Sheng.

Shi Sheng: "..." She has nothing to say to a future zombie king with no IQ!It’s just losing your IQ!

It was only at dawn that Sheng noticed Qian Li's change.

His face was completely like a normal person, only his eyes were still dull, lifeless and gloomy when not looking at Shi Sheng, which looked very scary.

Shi Sheng found that Qian Li and Bai Hu couldn't coexist peacefully. They were the kind of people who said, "I don't like you, and you are an eyesore to me."

After finding a broken car in the village, Shi Sheng drove the car shaky on the road.When Qian Li listened to her talk, she could also speak some simple words, and her IQ was obviously much higher than before.

He probably went to advance for a few days when he disappeared.

I don’t know what level this thing is now.

She still wants to go to City B. City B is the largest base nearby. Things like helicopters should have been gathered soon after the end of the world. They can only find helicopters there, and then go to the capital - to find their mother.

If she were to travel by land, given her current situation, she didn't know how long or how long it would take her to travel.

There are more and more abandoned cars on the cracked rural roads, broken limbs and legs on the ground, mixed with mud and blood, and a disgusting smell exudes in the air.

When Shi Sheng drove here, he could no longer drive forward.

After putting all the things in the White Tiger Space, Shi Sheng took Qian Li out of the car and walked forward.

There was a long queue in front of him, and Shi Sheng walked for a while before walking over, but...
